checks.imageQuestionAndZh: Travelers are seated next to luggage. There is no luggage loading, seat removal or repair. The unique key, zh-TW stem and all options/rationales match.

activeQuestion.prompt: Look at the picture and choose the statement that best describes it.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請看圖片，選出最符合畫面的敘述。

options.text: Travelers are lifting luggage onto an aircraft.
options.zh: 旅客正把行李搬上飛機。
options.whyZh: 畫面是室內等候情境，沒有登機或把行李抬上飛機的動作。

options.text: Some travelers are waiting beside their luggage.
options.zh: 一些旅客正在行李旁等候。
options.whyZh: 畫面可見旅客、座位與行李；旅客在行李旁等候是直接可觀察到的描述。

options.text: All the seats are being removed from the terminal.
options.zh: 航廈內所有座椅都正在被搬走。
options.whyZh: 座椅留在原處，圖中沒有搬走座椅的動作。

options.text: A suitcase is being repaired on a workbench.
options.zh: 一個行李箱正在工作檯上維修。
options.whyZh: 行李在旅客旁，沒有工作檯或維修行為。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 畫面可見旅客、座位與行李；旅客在行李旁等候是直接可觀察到的描述。
activeQuestion.evidence: Some travelers are waiting beside their luggage.

vocabulary.note: 不可數名詞；可用 a piece of luggage 表示一件行李。
